name: comp-362
title: Chart Data Tooltip
blurb: A tooltip showing chart-like data with colored bullet points and rows.
description: Tooltip displaying a date header and multi-row chart data, each row with a colored circle indicator and label/value pair.
use_when: Dashboard tooltips that show data point details at a glance (sales, revenue, costs).
avoid_when: Complex visualizations; tooltips should stay simple and scannable.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; colored circles are aria-hidden as decorative; tooltip is shown via hover only.
